name: Desygner
description_en:
Desygner is a design product whose current website is branded automo designer. The Google Play listing published by Desygner Pty Ltd explicitly says “Desygner is now part of Automo” and links the Desygner website. That publisher statement resolves the previously unexplained branding change, without proving account, subscription or asset migration.

The readable website advertises templates, visual design and PDF/document tools. Its web pricing page and mobile listing use different plan names and contain scope differences, so they are documented separately. An evaluator should confirm the actual editor, plan and rights needed before moving existing client work.
description_zh:
Desygner 是设计产品，其当前网站使用 automo designer 品牌。Desygner Pty Ltd 发布的 Google Play 条目明确说明“Desygner 现已成为 Automo 的一部分”，并链接 Desygner 官网。这一发布者说明解决了此前无法解释的品牌变化，但不证明账户、订阅或素材已完成迁移。

可读网站介绍模板、视觉设计及 PDF/文档工具。网页价格页与移动端条目使用不同套餐名称，范围也有差异，因此分别记录。迁移现有客户工作前，应确认实际编辑器、方案及所需权利。

core_features.explanation_en: The current site presents design and template categories for documents, social assets and other visual work.
core_features.explanation_zh: 当前网站列出文档、社交素材等视觉设计与模板类别。

core_features.explanation_en: The site lists PDF editing, signing and related document tools; availability in a selected account is not tested.
core_features.explanation_zh: 网站列出 PDF 编辑、签名及相关文档工具，具体账户可用性未测试。

core_features.name_zh: 按方案区分的团队容量
core_features.explanation_en: The web pricing page describes user, project, storage and AI-credit allowances that need plan-specific confirmation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 网页价格页说明用户、项目、存储和 AI 额度，需按具体方案核对。

sections.title_en: Identity evidence and remaining migration questions
sections.title_zh: 身份依据与剩余迁移问题
sections.en: The current desygner.com homepage identifies itself as automo designer. The separately archived [publisher listing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en_CA&id=com.delgeo.desygner), updated October 15, 2026, names Desygner Pty Ltd, links desygner.com and explicitly states the Automo relationship. This is stronger than a similar brand name or third-party directory, but does not establish transfer of existing accounts, designs or contracts. The original catalog name is retained.
sections.zh: 当前 desygner.com 首页自称 automo designer。另行留存的[发布者条目](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?hl=en_CA&id=com.delgeo.desygner)更新于 2026 年 10 月 15 日，署名 Desygner Pty Ltd、链接 desygner.com，并明确说明 Automo 关系。这比近似名称或第三方目录更直接，但不能证明既有账户、设计或合同转移；目录仍保留原产品名称。

sections.title_en: Evaluate the actual design and export workflow
sections.title_zh: 核对实际设计与导出流程
sections.en: The publisher’s mobile listing describes starting from a template or brief, editing layers, text, shapes and images, and exporting PNG/JPG/PDF. It advertises editable PDF and other design imports, plus brand assets and shared workspaces. These are mobile publisher claims preserved in external_primary_sources, not proof of identical web-editor behavior or import fidelity. A suitable pilot is one representative branded design and one imported PDF, checking editable elements, fonts and final export before transferring a library.
sections.zh: 移动端发布者条目说明可从模板或简要需求开始，编辑图层、文字、形状及图片，再导出 PNG/JPG/PDF；还宣传可编辑 PDF 等格式导入、品牌素材及共享工作区。这些移动端发布者主张保存在 external_primary_sources 中，不能证明网页编辑器行为完全相同或导入保真。可先用一份品牌设计和一份 PDF 样本检查可编辑元素、字体及最终导出，再迁移素材库。

sections.title_en: Conflicting web allowances and distinct mobile plans
sections.title_zh: 网页额度冲突与独立移动方案
sections.en: The web page lists Business at $19 per user/month and Team 100 at $333/month for up to 100 users. Its Free FAQ describes three users, three core apps, 100 projects, 20 monthly AI credits and 5 GB, while the page header makes a broader free-forever/20-team-member statement. Those limits cannot be safely combined. The mobile publisher listing instead names Free, Starter, Business and Scale; these are not established as interchangeable web subscriptions. Checkout currency, billing commitments, taxes and actual entitlements were not verified.
sections.zh: 网页列出 Business 每用户每月 $19，Team 100 每月 $333、最多 100 用户。Free FAQ 列出 3 用户、3 个核心应用、100 项目、每月 20 AI 额度及 5 GB，而页首又宣传永久免费及 20 团队成员，不能安全地将这些额度合并。移动端发布者条目使用 Free、Starter、Business、Scale 名称，尚不能视为可互换的网页订阅。结账币种、账期承诺、税费及实际权益未核实。

sections.en: The read terms page contains only a short introduction and site navigation, not a full operative contract. The pricing FAQ refers to a 14-day guarantee for Business and Team Unlimited even though its visible plan is named Team 100. Neither this wording nor royalty-free labels establish a complete commercial license for templates, stock assets or AI outputs. Confirm the applicable terms and refund process before purchase. No design import, editor operation, team permission, purchase, cancellation or migration was tested.
sections.zh: 实读条款页只有简短介绍和导航，并非完整有效合同。价格 FAQ 对 Business 与 Team Unlimited 提及 14 天保证，但可见套餐名为 Team 100；这类文字及免版税标签都不足以构成模板、素材或 AI 输出的完整商业许可。购买前需确认适用条款及退款流程。本轮未测试设计导入、编辑器操作、团队权限、购买、取消或迁移。
